notes: Fiscal year ended June 30, 2026. Taxes: the supplemental line 'Cash paid for taxes' ($274 million, us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaid, gross of refunds, consistent with the gross figure used for FY2025). The income-tax note's new by-jurisdiction table gives total net cash paid for taxes of $272 million after $2 million of refunds (U.S. federal 1, U.S. states 15, Australia 185, U.K. 54, other 17). R&D not reported as a separate line in the FY2026 10-K.
